name: iCloud Private Relay
notes: 285,106 rows (12 MB) - sync-time download (ip source icloud-private-relay). Bundled prefixes are the rows quoted in the research only. Apple: "Consider treating these addresses like larger carrier-grade NAT"; relay IP stable per browsing session; Private Access Tokens recommended over CAPTCHAs.

name: Cloudflare WARP / Zero Trust Gateway
notes: Cloudflare "does not publish One Client egress ranges"; users egress from the shared AS13335 pool. Only ingress ranges are documented (WireGuard 162.159.193.0/24, MASQUE 162.159.197.0/24, FedRAMP 162.159.239.0/24, consumer 162.159.192.0/24): these never appear as client IPs at an origin, so they are kept in ingressPrefixes, not prefixes. Anubis penalises AS13335 (false-positive trap).

name: Zscaler ZIA
notes: ~131 KB JSON grouped by continent/city; bundled prefix is the research example ("Abu Dhabi II"). Reverse/zero-trust proxies obscure bot signals (Vercel/Zscaler incident).
